text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: As for the second part, the story begins with the elf village as the stage! It seems there are bosses and new quests prepared that are different from the first part, so please try to play them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
後編は、エルフの里を舞台に物語の続きが始まります！
前編とは異なるボスや、新しいクエストも用意されているみたいなので、
ぜひプレイしてみてくださいね！
